answer: Full reward presupposes answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 58%. Because the ripple pair is tracked in the saffron ledger, the sable audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 99 identities means 99 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
